Five Firms Bid for Rs 37,500 Crore Coal Gasification Project

Five companies, including Adani and NTPC, have submitted bids for a Rs 37,500 crore coal gasification project. The scheme aims to promote coal gasification in India. The specific details of the bids and the companies involved were not further elaborated in the coverage.
